summary: Andorra's government says the Principality does not require any type of visa and is not a member of the Schengen Area: access is through France or Spain, and third-country nationals who need a Schengen visa must apply for a double-entry or multiple-entry one. The Government of Canada says Andorra has no airport and that you will have to meet the entry, exit and visa requirements for France or Spain.

stayDays.text: This Regulation establishes the procedures and conditions for issuing visas for intended stays on the territory of the Member States not exceeding 90 days in any 180-day period.

extendable.text: The period of validity and/or the duration of stay of an issued visa shall be extended where the competent authority of a Member State considers that a visa holder has provided proof of force majeure or humanitarian reasons preventing him from leaving the territory of the Member States before the expiry of the period of validity of or the duration of stay authorised by the visa.

passportValidity.text: The UK Foreign Office says your passport must have a date of issue less than 10 years before the date you arrive and an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen Area.

source.name: UK FCDO — Andorra travel advice (entry requirements)

travelInsurance.text: No official source we could read states whether travel insurance is required to enter Andorra. The EU Visa Code requires applicants for a Schengen visa for one or two entries — Andorra's government says travellers who need a Schengen visa must hold a double-entry or multiple-entry one — to prove they hold travel medical insurance with minimum coverage of EUR 30,000. The UK government says the EHIC and GHIC are not valid in Andorra and to take out comprehensive travel and medical insurance before travelling.

source.name: Visa Code (Regulation (EC) No 810/2009), consolidated text — EUR-Lex

alsoStatedOn.name: UK FCDO — Andorra travel advice: health

onwardTicket.text: No official source we could read states whether a return or onward ticket is required. Andorra's government says the Principality does not require any type of visa and that access is through France or Spain.

proofOfFunds.text: No official source we could read states a funds requirement for Andorra.

currencyLimits.text: Spain's tax agency, in its leaflet for travellers coming from Andorra, says cash of EUR 10,000 or more (or the equivalent in other currencies) must be declared when you enter or leave the European Union. No Andorran official source we could find states Andorra's own threshold.

source.name: Agencia Tributaria (Spanish Customs) — leaflet for travellers arriving from the Principality of Andorra

notes: The UK FCDO says Andorra is not a member of the EU and that you may have to pay taxes and duties on tobacco, liquor and luxury goods when you re-enter France and Spain; customs officers may impound excess amounts of tobacco and the vehicle transporting it.

safety.text: The UK Foreign Office says street crime is rare but gives precautions to take, that although there is no recent history of terrorism in Andorra attacks cannot be ruled out, and that if you plan to ski you should check safety advice, including on avalanches, before you travel.

tips.text: If you require a visa to enter the Schengen Area, the Government of Canada says to make sure you hold a multiple-entry visa before travelling to Andorra: holders of a single-entry visa will face delays and may be refused re-entry when trying to return to France or Spain.
Andorra is landlocked and has no airport, according to the Government of Canada; you must enter through France or Spain.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Andorra?
faq.answer: Andorra's government says the Principality does not require any type of visa, and that access is through France or Spain because Andorra is not a member of the Schengen Area. The Government of Canada says you will have to meet the entry, exit and visa requirements for France or Spain. If you need a Schengen visa, the Andorran government says to apply for a double-entry or multiple-entry one, depending on how many times you will enter the Schengen Area from Andorra.

faq.question: Does time in Andorra count against my 90-day Schengen allowance?
faq.answer: Andorra's government says the Principality is not a member of the Schengen Area. The EU visa regulation sets the visa exemption for listed nationalities at stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period. No official source we could read states whether days spent in Andorra count towards that limit.

faq.question: Can I visit Andorra on a single-entry Schengen visa?
faq.answer: Andorra's government says travellers who need a Schengen visa must apply for a double-entry or multiple-entry one, and Canada's travel advice says holders of a single-entry visa will face delays and may be refused re-entry when trying to return to France or Spain.

faq.question: How do I get to Andorra without an airport?
faq.answer: Through France or Spain: Andorra has no airport (Government of Canada). From 1 November to 15 May, you must use winter tyres or carry snow chains in Andorra (UK FCDO).

faq.question: What currency does Andorra use?
faq.answer: The European Commission says Andorra, which is neither in the EU nor in the euro area, has concluded a monetary agreement with the EU that lets it produce limited quantities of euro coins with its own national design, but not issue euro banknotes.
